cases.source: The application starts without opening a main window, and the menu bar icon provides access to settings and recent transcripts. Recording should begin only after the microphone has opened successfully. If the input device disconnects, the application must tell the user that the recording was interrupted and preserve the audio already captured. A failed transcription should not erase the recording or paste an incomplete result into another application. We also need to keep model preparation separate from active inference so that a slow download does not block an ordinary dictation. These requirements apply to both the keyboard shortcut and the recording button. The next review should cover startup, cancellation, recovery, and the behavior when the settings file cannot be read.
